title: NewSpawn
description: This is a plugin which lets you create a custom server spawn.
body:
NewSpawn is a Minecraft paper plugin that lets you set a custom spawn on your Minecraft server, this is the Alpha release so there can be bugs!
# Commands
1. /spawn -teleport to Spawn
2. Operators, admins only:
3. /spawn set -makes a new server spawn 
1. Make sure to check out my other plugins that are on this organization or on my profile (TheRealPJ).
